newsitem.title: LATVIA: SOCCER-SHEVLYAKOV'S GOALS EARN LATVIA THEIR FIRST WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHEVLYAKOV'S GOALS EARN LATVIA THEIR FIRST WIN.

text.p: Midfielder Juri Shevlyakov earned Latvia their first win in World Cup qualifying group four when he scored both goals in the 2-0 defeat of Belarus on Wednesday.
The victory lifted them off the bottom of the group table. Both they and Belarus have four points but Latvia have a better goal difference.
Shevlyakov opening the scoring in the 38th minute and sealed Belarus's fate with a delightful second seven minutes from time.
He chipped the ball over goalkeeper Valeri Shantolosov on the edge of the box and walked the ball into the net.
Oleg Karavajev was a commanding presence in the Latvian goal as Belarus pressed hard for an equaliser in the second half.
